_comment: Image prompts for the Edition Rent luxury car-rental site. Edit prompts freely. 'name' becomes the output filename (assets/<name>.<output_format>). Model slugs: 'google/nano-banana' (fast, cheap, great default), 'google/nano-banana-pro', or 'flux-kontext-pro'. image_size accepts ratios like '16:9', '4:3', '3:4', '1:1'. Confirm exact slugs on https://kie.ai/market/text-to-image
